title: Brandon Fugal to have Marrs' sphere tested in Utah lab

tellings.quote: he told me, "I'm sorry, Ross. Brandon Fugal's agreed to fly out in his private jet to Utah where he's going to have it tested in the lab."

plain: A strange sphere connected to the late author Jim Marrs was to be flown to Utah and tested in a lab, with the Utah businessman Brandon Fugal agreeing to carry it in his private jet. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart tells this, saying that when he asked about the object he was told, "I'm sorry, Ross," because Fugal had already taken on the testing, which would mean the object was thought worth serious scientific study.
